comments_data.body:
Thanks @lilitkarapetyan .

But, once the wargame has been initiated, we should create a new document with the `_id` of `settings`.

So, before initiated:
- ***overwrite*** document named `initial_wargame`

After initiated:
- ***add new version*** of document named `settings`

Ok. It's a start, but something still broken.

1. Login as Game Control
2. Do "umpire laydown" (move 4 assets)
3. Submit "umpire laydown"
4. Go to Game Admin page
5. Click on `wargame initiated`
6. Log in as `Red CO`
7. Note we're now in `Force laydown`
8. Do force laydown for `MPA 2`. Remember where MPA2 asset placed
9. Submit force laydown
10. Notice where `MPA 2` is
11. Refresh page
12. `MPA 2` back in `Force laydown`
13. Look in database:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/178493176-adebafe2-5c0f-472f-a227-1443ae1d6c07.png)

The results of `Force laydown` are in document titled `initial_wargame`.  But, this document isn't supplied to the client on refresh.  It _may_ be filtered by this code:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/178492867-5c401812-3d8a-450c-af30-251e3a24673c.png)

So, `get all documents for wargame` doesn't return the one titled `initial_wargame`.  This is the one with the results of Red `force laydown` (i.e. a position for `MPA 2`).
Thanks for the update @lilitkarapetyan , but isn't `settings` the name we use for the wargame document once it has been initiated?

Sorry, @lilitkarapetyan - this is still broken.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/178745205-634b5450-92d3-457b-815b-ee0eb5ef795d.png)

I did `umpire-laydown`, then `initiate wargame`.  This produced a wargame with the new id (`initial_wargame_start`). But, when I changed a channel name & did `Save channel`,  it created a wargame with a date-time id.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/178745482-66fb0663-111c-4c9e-a727-7dbc5df67ac6.png)

Ok, I've made some progress with this today.  I'll carry on tomorrow. I will be doing more refactoring of `wargames_api`. I haven't really worked with it before, but there are some bits that look wrong.
